title: Step 5 — Reserve Tokenisation: ask to convert 8,000,000 fCeBM into tCeBM
description: The payer bank requests a tokenisation escrow for 8,000,000 of its 10,000,000 fCeBM. This is the step that makes the bank able to settle: POST /api/v1/htlc/lock locks tCeBM the bank must already hold.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway (spoke-crc), which proxies to BCCR. The create half of the reserve lifecycle is registered only on a commercial-bank gateway; a Central Bank gateway answers 404 on this path. Same verified divergence as the deposit: the 201 body is {escrow_id} alone, with no status field. Scenario divergence: Scenario B's equivalent request also carries deposit_id linking the escrow to the approved deposit; Scenario A's does not.
